segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ רְשׁוּת הַגָּבוֹהַּ בְּכֶסֶף, וּרְשׁוּת הַהֶדְיוֹט בַּחֲזָקָה. אֲמִירָתוֹ לְגָבוֹהַּ – כִּמְסִירָתוֹ לְהֶדְיוֹט.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» «The authority of the Temple» treasury effects acquisition «by» means of «money» to the seller. «And the authority,» i.e., the mode of acquisition, «of a commoner» [«hedyot»] «is by possession.» Furthermore, «one’s declaration to the Most High,» i.e., when one consecrates an item through speech, «is equivalent to transferring» an item «to a common person,» and the item is acquired by the Temple treasury through his mere speech.

moves.summary: modes of acquisition for the Temple treasury versus a commoner

positions.claim: the Temple treasury acquires by money, a commoner by possession; a declaration to the Most High equals delivery to a commoner
